description: This file contains unit tests for the in-memory grain storage provider in an Orleans-based project. It verifies that the memory storage correctly implements persistence operations, even though the storage is non-durable. The class MemoryGrainStorageTests inherits from a test runner to execute a suite of persistence tests, and includes configuration for setting up the test cluster with multiple memory storage providers.

classes.description: Unit test class for in-memory grain storage provider, testing its compliance with persistence operations within an Orleans silo environment.
